create_RotaryEmbedding: create a RotaryEmbedding instance with head_size, rotary_dim, max_position_embeddings, base, is_neox_style, and dtype parameters
create_LinearScalingRotaryEmbedding: create a LinearScalingRotaryEmbedding instance with scaling_factors supporting multiple LoRA adapter contexts
run_forward_native: run the native PyTorch forward pass on query and key tensors with positional embeddings
run_forward_cuda: run the CUDA-optimized forward pass with optional fused KV buffer arguments
run_forward_npu: run the NPU-optimized forward pass using npu_mrope kernel for query and key tensors
